Context: 3. Regular Promotions

- (a) Assessment of vacancies.Actual number of existing vacancies to be filled by promotion will be ascertained from Establishment Register, Incumbency Register and Vacancy Register / Roster Register prescribed in D. P. & Trg., O.M. No. 35014/2/80, Estt. (D), dated 7-2-1986. Expected vacancies due to retirement, new posts, etc., will be added.
